questions.question_english: A 10-year-old child from a migrant family has never been enrolled in any school. The parents approach a local government school for admission. As per the provisions of the RTE Act, 2009, what must the Principal do?
options_english: Deny admission as the child has missed foundational primary classes.
Admit the child in Class 1 to build foundational literacy and numeracy.
Admit the child in an age-appropriate class (Class 5) and provide special training.
Direct the parents to an open schooling center as regular school cannot accommodate overage children.
questions.explanation_english: Admit the child in an age-appropriate class (Class 5) and provide special training. Section 4 specifies that a child who has never been admitted to any school or could not complete elementary education must be admitted to a class appropriate to their age. To enable such a child to adjust and keep pace with peers, the institution must provide specialized training through designed learning materials for a prescribed period after admission.
questions.explanation_hindi: RTE अधिनियम की धारा 4 के अनुसार, कभी विद्यालय में प्रवेश न लेने वाले या प्रारंभिक शिक्षा पूरी न कर पाने वाले बच्चे को उसकी आयु के अनुरूप कक्षा में प्रवेश दिया जाना चाहिए। साथ ही उसे सहपाठियों के स्तर तक पहुँचने और कक्षा में समायोजित होने के लिए विशेष प्रशिक्षण उपलब्ध कराया जाना चाहिए। केवल उम्र अधिक होने या पहले नामांकन न होने के कारण प्रवेश अस्वीकार करना अधिनियम की इस व्यवस्था के विपरीत होगा।
